Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Repository structure
4. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:

package io.flutter.plugins;

import androidx.annotation.Keep;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import io.flutter.Log;

import io.flutter.embedding.engine.FlutterEngine;

/**
 * Generated file. Do not edit.
 * This file is generated by the Flutter tool based on the
 * plugins that support the Android platform.
 */
@Keep
public final class GeneratedPluginRegistrant {
  private static final String TAG = "GeneratedPluginRegistrant";
  public static void registerWith(@NonNull FlutterEngine flutterEngine) {
    try {
      flutterEngine.getPlugins().add(new dev.fluttercommunity.plus.androidintent.AndroidIntentPlugin());
    } catch (Exception e) {
      Log.e(TAG, "Error registering plugin android_intent_plus, dev.fluttercommunity.plus.androidintent.AndroidIntentPlugin", e);

      Log.e(TAG, "Error registering plugin app_links, com.llfbandit.app_links.AppLinksPlugin", e);

File: android/build.gradle.kts
================
allprojects {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
    }
}

val newBuildDir: Directory =
    rootProject.layout.buildDirectory
        .dir("../../build")
        .get()
rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.value(newBuildDir)

subprojects {
    val newSubprojectBuildDir: Directory = newBuildDir.dir(project.name)
    project.layout.buildDirectory.value(newSubprojectBuildDir)
}

// Sobreescribe compileSdk = 36 en todos los plugins DESPUÉS de que carguen su configuración
subprojects {
    afterEvaluate {
        val android = project.extensions.findByName("android") as? com.android.build.gradle.BaseExtension
        android?.compileSdkVersion(36)
    }
}

// DEBE ir después del bloque afterEvaluate
subprojects {
    project.evaluationDependsOn(":app")
}

tasks.register<Delete>("clean") {
    delete(rootProject.layout.buildDirectory)
}

pluginManagement {
    val flutterSdkPath =
        run {
            val properties = java.util.Properties()
            file("local.properties").inputStream().use { properties.load(it) }
            val flutterSdkPath = properties.getProperty("flutter.sdk")
            require(flutterSdkPath != null) { "flutter.sdk not set in local.properties" }
            flutterSdkPath
        }

    includeBuild("$flutterSdkPath/packages/flutter_tools/gradle")

    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        gradlePluginPortal()
    }
}

</Scheme>

# Launch Screen Assets

You can customize the launch screen with your own desired assets by replacing the image files in this directory.

You can also do it by opening your Flutter project's Xcode project with `open ios/Runner.xcworkspace`, selecting `Runner/Assets.xcassets` in the Project Navigator and dropping in the desired images.

================
File: lib/main.dart
================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'config/supabase_config.dart';
import 'providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import 'providers/subject_provider.dart';
import 'providers/user_provider.dart';
import 'theme/app_colors.dart';
import 'screens/splash_screen.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  await Supabase.initialize(
    url: SupabaseConfig.url,
    publishableKey: SupabaseConfig.anonKey,
  );

  runApp(
    MultiProvider(
      providers: [
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AccessibilityProvider()),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => SubjectProvider()),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => UserProvider()),
      ],
      child: const MyApp(),
    ),
  );
}

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Consumer<AccessibilityProvider>(
      builder: (context, accessibility, child) {
        final activeColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;

        return MaterialApp(
          title: 'Tutor IA Accesible',
          debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,

          themeMode: accessibility.isHighContrast
              ? ThemeMode.dark
              : accessibility.themeMode,

          // --- TEMA CLARO ---
          theme: ThemeData(
            useMaterial3: true,
            brightness: Brightness.light,
            primaryColor: activeColor,
            colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
              seedColor: activeColor,
              primary: activeColor,
              brightness: Brightness.light,
              surface: AppColors.background,
            ),
            scaffoldBackgroundColor: AppColors.background,
            cardTheme: const CardThemeData(
              color: Colors.white,
              elevation: 1,
            ),
            appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
              backgroundColor: activeColor,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              elevation: 0,
            ),
          ),

          // --- TEMA OSCURO Y ALTO CONTRASTE ---
          darkTheme: ThemeData(
            useMaterial3: true,
            brightness: Brightness.dark,
            primaryColor: activeColor,
            colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
              seedColor: activeColor,
              primary: activeColor,
              brightness: Brightness.dark,
              surface: accessibility.isHighContrast
                  ? Colors.black
                  : const Color(0xFF1E232A),
            ),
            scaffoldBackgroundColor: accessibility.isHighContrast
                ? Colors.black
                : const Color(0xFF14171D),
            cardTheme: CardThemeData(
              color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                  ? Colors.grey.shade900
                  : const Color(0xFF222831),
              elevation: 2,
            ),
            appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
              backgroundColor: accessibility.isHighContrast
                  ? Colors.black
                  : const Color(0xFF1E232A),
              foregroundColor: accessibility.isHighContrast
                  ? Colors.yellowAccent
                  : Colors.white,
              elevation: 0,
            ),
          ),

          home: const SplashScreen(),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

================
File: lib/models/material_model.dart
================
class StudyMaterial {
  final String id;
  final String subjectId;
  final String title;
  final String? description;
  final String fileUrl;
  final String fileName;
  final String uploadedBy;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  StudyMaterial({
    required this.id,
    required this.subjectId,
    required this.title,
    this.description,
    required this.fileUrl,
    required this.fileName,
    this.uploadedBy = '',
    required this.createdAt,
  });

  factory StudyMaterial.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return StudyMaterial(
      id: map['id']?.toString() ?? '',
      subjectId: map['subject_id']?.toString() ?? '',
      title: map['title']?.toString() ?? '',
      description: map['description']?.toString(),
      fileUrl: map['file_url']?.toString() ?? '',
      fileName: map['file_name']?.toString() ?? '',
      uploadedBy: map['uploaded_by']?.toString() ?? '',
      createdAt: map['created_at'] != null
          ? DateTime.parse(map['created_at'].toString())
          : DateTime.now(),
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'subject_id': subjectId,
      'title': title,
      'description': description,
      'file_url': fileUrl,
      'file_name': fileName,
      'uploaded_by': uploadedBy,
    };
  }

  factory StudyMaterial.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      StudyMaterial.fromMap(json);
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => toMap();
}

================
File: lib/models/subject.dart
================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class Subject {
  final String id;
  final String teacherId;
  final String name;
  final String description;
  final String year;
  final String division;
  final int iconCode;
  final int colorValue;

  Subject({
    required this.id,
    this.teacherId = '',
    required this.name,
    this.description = '',
    this.year = '',
    this.division = '',
    required this.iconCode,
    required this.colorValue,
  });

  IconData get icon => IconData(iconCode, fontFamily: 'MaterialIcons');
  Color get color => Color(colorValue);

  factory Subject.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return Subject(
      id: map['id']?.toString() ?? '',
      teacherId: map['teacher_id']?.toString() ?? '',
      name: map['name']?.toString() ?? '',
      description: map['description']?.toString() ?? '',
      year: map['year']?.toString() ?? '',
      division: map['division']?.toString() ?? '',
      iconCode: map['icon_code'] ?? map['iconCode'] ?? 57415,
      colorValue: map['color_value'] ?? map['colorValue'] ?? 0xFF2196F3,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'teacher_id': teacherId,
      'name': name,
      'description': description,
      'year': year,
      'division': division,
      'icon_code': iconCode,
      'color_value': colorValue,
    };
  }

  factory Subject.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => Subject.fromMap(json);
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => toMap();
}

File: lib/models/user_model.dart

class UserModel {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final String role; // 'docente', 'estudiante', 'profesional'
  final bool modoTea;
  final bool lecturaFacil;
  final bool altoContraste;
  final bool lenguaSenas;

  UserModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.role,
    this.modoTea = false,
    this.lecturaFacil = false,
    this.altoContraste = false,
    this.lenguaSenas = false,
  });

  factory UserModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final settings =
        json['accessibility_settings'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    return UserModel(
      id: json['id'] ?? '',
      name: json['full_name'] ?? 'Usuario',
      role: json['role'] ?? 'estudiante',
      modoTea: settings['modo_tea'] ?? false,
      lecturaFacil: settings['lectura_facil'] ?? false,
      altoContraste: settings['alto_contraste'] ?? false,
      lenguaSenas: settings['lengua_senas'] ?? false,
    );
  }
}

================
File: lib/providers/accessibility_provider.dart
================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../theme/app_colors.dart';

class AccessibilityProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  double _fontSize = 16.0;
  bool _isTeaMode = false;
  bool _autoReadText = false;
  bool _isSignLanguageEnabled = false;

  bool _isHighContrast = false;
  bool _isDyslexicFriendly = false;
  double _speechRate = 0.5;

  bool _isColorBlindMode = false;
  bool _isFocusMode = false;

  Color _customColor = AppColors.darkBlue;
  ThemeMode _themeMode = ThemeMode.system;

  // Getters
  double get fontSize => _fontSize;
  bool get isTeaMode => _isTeaMode;
  bool get autoReadText => _autoReadText;
  bool get isSignLanguageEnabled => _isSignLanguageEnabled;
  bool get isHighContrast => _isHighContrast;
  bool get isDyslexicFriendly => _isDyslexicFriendly;
  double get speechRate => _speechRate;
  bool get isColorBlindMode => _isColorBlindMode;
  bool get isFocusMode => _isFocusMode;
  Color get customColor => _customColor;
  ThemeMode get themeMode => _themeMode;

  // Color principal activo según prioridades de accesibilidad
  Color get activePrimaryColor {
    if (_isHighContrast) return Colors.yellowAccent;
    if (_isColorBlindMode) return Colors.blue.shade700;
    return _customColor;
  }

  AccessibilityProvider() {
    _loadSettings();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _fontSize = prefs.getDouble('fontSize') ?? 16.0;
    _isTeaMode = prefs.getBool('isTeaMode') ?? false;
    _autoReadText = prefs.getBool('autoReadText') ?? false;
    _isSignLanguageEnabled = prefs.getBool('isSignLanguageEnabled') ?? false;
    _isHighContrast = prefs.getBool('isHighContrast') ?? false;
    _isDyslexicFriendly = prefs.getBool('isDyslexicFriendly') ?? false;
    _speechRate = prefs.getDouble('speechRate') ?? 0.5;
    _isColorBlindMode = prefs.getBool('isColorBlindMode') ?? false;
    _isFocusMode = prefs.getBool('isFocusMode') ?? false;

    final savedColor = prefs.getInt('customColor');
    if (savedColor != null) {
      _customColor = Color(savedColor);
    }

    final savedThemeIndex = prefs.getInt('themeMode');
    if (savedThemeIndex != null) {
      _themeMode = ThemeMode.values[savedThemeIndex];
    }

    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setCustomColor(Color color) async {
    _customColor = color;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setInt('customColor', color.value);
  }

  void setThemeMode(ThemeMode mode) async {
    _themeMode = mode;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setInt('themeMode', mode.index);
  }

  void setFontSize(double size) async {
    _fontSize = size;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setDouble('fontSize', size);
  }

  void toggleTeaMode(bool value) async {
    _isTeaMode = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('isTeaMode', value);
  }

  void toggleAutoRead(bool value) async {
    _autoReadText = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('autoReadText', value);
  }

  void toggleAutoReadText(bool value) => toggleAutoRead(value);

  void toggleSignLanguage(bool value) async {
    _isSignLanguageEnabled = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('isSignLanguageEnabled', value);
  }

  void toggleHighContrast(bool value) async {
    _isHighContrast = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('isHighContrast', value);
  }

  void toggleDyslexicFriendly(bool value) async {
    _isDyslexicFriendly = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('isDyslexicFriendly', value);
  }

  void setSpeechRate(double rate) async {
    _speechRate = rate;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setDouble('speechRate', rate);
  }

  void toggleColorBlindMode(bool value) async {
    _isColorBlindMode = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('isColorBlindMode', value);
  }

  void toggleFocusMode(bool value) async {
    _isFocusMode = value;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    prefs.setBool('isFocusMode', value);
  }

  TextStyle getTextStyle({
    double? overrideSize,
    Color? color,
    FontWeight? fontWeight,
  }) {
    return TextStyle(
      fontSize: overrideSize ?? _fontSize,
      color: color,
      fontWeight: fontWeight ??
          (_isDyslexicFriendly ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal),
      letterSpacing: _isDyslexicFriendly ? 1.2 : 0.0,
      wordSpacing: _isDyslexicFriendly ? 2.0 : 0.0,
      height: _isDyslexicFriendly ? 1.5 : 1.2,
    );
  }
}

================
File: lib/providers/subject_provider.dart
================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../models/subject.dart';

class SubjectProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  final _supabase = Supabase.instance.client;
  List<Subject> _subjects = [];
  bool _isLoading = false;

  List<Subject> get subjects => _subjects;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  SubjectProvider() {
    fetchSubjects();
  }

  Future<void> fetchSubjects() async {
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final response = await _supabase.from('subjects').select();

      // Imprime en la consola de VS Code para ver la respuesta exacta
      debugPrint('>>> MATERIAS DESDE SUPABASE: $response');

      final List<dynamic> data = response as List<dynamic>;
      _subjects = data.map((json) => Subject.fromMap(json)).toList();
      debugPrint('>>> MATERIAS CARGADAS EN MEMORIA: ${_subjects.length}');
    } catch (e, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('❌ ERROR AL CARGAR MATERIAS: $e');
      debugPrint('$stackTrace');
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> addSubject(Subject subject) async {
    try {
      final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
      final map = subject.toMap();

      if (user != null &&
          (map['teacher_id'] == null || map['teacher_id'].toString().isEmpty)) {
        map['teacher_id'] = user.id;
      }

      if (map['id'] == null || map['id'].toString().isEmpty) {
        map.remove('id');
      }

      final response =
          await _supabase.from('subjects').insert(map).select().single();
      final newSubject = Subject.fromMap(response);

      _subjects.add(newSubject);
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ ERROR AL AGREGAR MATERIA: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteSubject(String id) async {
    try {
      await _supabase.from('subjects').delete().eq('id', id);
      _subjects.removeWhere((sub) => sub.id == id);
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ ERROR AL ELIMINAR MATERIA: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }
}

================
File: lib/providers/user_provider.dart
================
// lib/providers/user_provider.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

class UserProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const String _defaultName = 'Usuario Inclusivo';
  static const String _defaultRole = 'Estudiante';

  String _name = _defaultName;
  String _email = '';
  String _profileImagePath = '';
  String _role = _defaultRole;
  bool _onboardingCompleted = false;

  String get name => _name;
  String get email => _email;
  String get profileImagePath => _profileImagePath;
  String get role => _role;
  String get userRole => _role; // Alias para compatibilidad
  bool get onboardingCompleted => _onboardingCompleted;

  SupabaseClient get _supabase => Supabase.instance.client;

  UserProvider() {
    _loadUserData();
  }

  /// Carga primero la caché local y luego sincroniza con Supabase.
  Future<void> _loadUserData() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _name = prefs.getString('user_name') ?? _defaultName;
    _email = prefs.getString('user_email') ?? '';
    _profileImagePath = prefs.getString('user_photo') ?? '';
    _role = prefs.getString('user_role') ?? _defaultRole;
    _onboardingCompleted = prefs.getBool('onboarding_completed') ?? false;
    notifyListeners();

    if (_supabase.auth.currentUser != null) {
      await loadFromSupabase();
    }
  }

  /// Trae los datos del perfil desde la base de datos Supabase.
  Future<void> loadFromSupabase() async {
    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;

    try {
      final data = await _supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select()
          .eq('id', user.id)
          .maybeSingle();

      _email = user.email ?? '';

      final dbName = data?['name'] as String?;
      _name = (dbName != null && dbName.isNotEmpty) ? dbName : _defaultName;

      _profileImagePath = (data?['photo_url'] as String?) ?? '';
      _role = (data?['role'] as String?) ?? _role;
      _onboardingCompleted = (data?['onboarding_completed'] as bool?) ?? false;

      await _saveCache();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error al cargar el perfil: $e');
      _email = user.email ?? _email;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _saveCache() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString('user_name', _name);
    await prefs.setString('user_email', _email);
    await prefs.setString('user_photo', _profileImagePath);
    await prefs.setString('user_role', _role);
    await prefs.setBool('onboarding_completed', _onboardingCompleted);
  }

  Future<void> setRole(String newRole) async {
    _role = newRole;
    notifyListeners();
    await _saveCache();

    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      try {
        await _supabase
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'role': newRole}).eq('id', user.id);
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Error al actualizar el rol: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  /// Setea el rol seleccionado en el onboarding y lo guarda en Supabase
  Future<void> setRoleAndCompleteOnboarding(String selectedRole) async {
    _role = selectedRole;
    _onboardingCompleted = true;
    notifyListeners();
    await _saveCache();

    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      try {
        await _supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
          'id': user.id,
          'name': _name,
          'email': _email,
          'role': selectedRole,
          'onboarding_completed': true,
        });
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Error al completar el onboarding en Supabase: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> updateName(String newName) async {
    _name = newName;
    notifyListeners();
    await _saveCache();

    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      try {
        await _supabase
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'name': newName}).eq('id', user.id);
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Error al actualizar el nombre: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> updateEmail(String newEmail) async {
    _email = newEmail;
    notifyListeners();
    await _saveCache();
  }

  Future<void> updateProfileImage(String path) async {
    _profileImagePath = path;
    notifyListeners();
    await _saveCache();

    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      try {
        await _supabase
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'photo_url': path}).eq('id', user.id);
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Error al actualizar la foto: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  /// Cierra la sesión y limpia la caché local.
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    await _supabase.auth.signOut();

    _name = _defaultName;
    _email = '';
    _profileImagePath = '';
    _role = _defaultRole;
    _onboardingCompleted = false;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove('user_name');
    await prefs.remove('user_email');
    await prefs.remove('user_photo');
    await prefs.remove('user_role');
    await prefs.remove('onboarding_completed');

    notifyListeners();
  }

  Widget getDefaultAvatar({required double radius, required Color color}) {
    return CircleAvatar(
      radius: radius,
      backgroundColor: color.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
      child: Text(
        _name.isNotEmpty ? _name[0].toUpperCase() : 'U',
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: radius,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          color: color,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

File: lib/screens/auth_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import '../services/psico_auth.dart';
import 'main_navigation_screen.dart';
import 'onboarding_screen.dart';
import 'psico_panel_screen.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';
import 'teacher_panel_screen.dart'; // Importante

class AuthScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuthScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AuthScreen> createState() => _AuthScreenState();
}

class _AuthScreenState extends State<AuthScreen> {
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isLogin = true;
  bool _loading = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _nameController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _showMessage(String text) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text;
    final name = _nameController.text.trim();

    if (email.isEmpty || !email.contains('@')) {
      _showMessage('Ingresa un correo electrónico válido.');
      return;
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      _showMessage('La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.');
      return;
    }
    if (!_isLogin && name.isEmpty) {
      _showMessage('Ingresa tu nombre completo.');
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _loading = true);
    final supabase = Supabase.instance.client;

    try {
      if (_isLogin) {
        await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(
          email: email,
          password: password,
        );
      } else {
        final res = await supabase.auth.signUp(
          email: email,
          password: password,
          data: {'name': name},
        );

        if (res.session == null) {
          _showMessage(
            'Revisa tu correo para confirmar tu cuenta y luego inicia sesión.',
          );
          if (mounted) setState(() => _isLogin = true);
          return;
        }
      }

      if (!mounted) return;

      // Sincronizar datos del usuario con el Provider
      final userProvider = context.read<UserProvider>();
      await userProvider.loadFromSupabase();

      if (!mounted) return;

      final role = userProvider.role.toLowerCase();

      // Psicopedagoga
      if (role == 'psicopedagoga') {
        Navigator.pushReplacement(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const PsicoPanelScreen()),
        );
        return;
      }

      // Docente / Profesor
      if (role == 'docente') {
        Navigator.pushReplacement(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const TeacherPanelScreen()),
        );
        return;
      }

      // Alumno / Referente
      if (!userProvider.onboardingCompleted) {
        Navigator.pushReplacement(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const OnboardingScreen()),
        );
      } else {
        Navigator.pushReplacement(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigationScreen()),
        );
      }
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      _showMessage(e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      _showMessage(
        'Ocurrió un error. Revisa tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.',
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accessibility = Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context);
    final primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bgColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.black
        : Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor;
    final textColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.yellowAccent
        : (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bgColor,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.accessibility_new, color: primaryColor, size: 32),
            tooltip: 'Ajustes de Accesibilidad',
            onPressed: () async {
              final ok = await PsicoAuth.showDialogGate(context);
              if (ok && context.mounted) {
                Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (context) => const SettingsScreen()),
                );
              }
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Icon(
                  Icons.school,
                  size: 80,
                  color: primaryColor,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                Text(
                  'EducInclusiva IA',
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                    overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: primaryColor,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Text(
                  _isLogin
                      ? 'Inicia sesión para continuar'
                      : 'Crea tu cuenta inclusiva',
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                    overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.9,
                    color: textColor,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 32),
                if (!_isLogin) ...[
                  _buildTextField(
                    controller: _nameController,
                    label: 'Nombre Completo',
                    icon: Icons.person,
                    accessibility: accessibility,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                ],
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _emailController,
                  label: 'Correo Electrónico',
                  icon: Icons.email,
                  accessibility: accessibility,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _passwordController,
                  label: 'Contraseña',
                  icon: Icons.lock,
                  isPassword: true,
                  accessibility: accessibility,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 32),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  height: 55,
                  child: ElevatedButton(
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      ),
                    ),
                    onPressed: _loading ? null : _submit,
                    child: _loading
                        ? SizedBox(
                            height: 24,
                            width: 24,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                              strokeWidth: 2,
                              color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                  ? Colors.black
                                  : Colors.white,
                            ),
                          )
                        : Text(
                            _isLogin ? 'Ingresar' : 'Registrarme',
                            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                              color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                  ? Colors.black
                                  : Colors.white,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: _loading
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          setState(() {
                            _isLogin = !_isLogin;
                          });
                        },
                  child: Text(
                    _isLogin
                        ? '¿No tienes cuenta? Regístrate aquí'
                        : '¿Ya tienes cuenta? Inicia sesión',
                    style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                      color: primaryColor,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTextField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    required AccessibilityProvider accessibility,
    bool isPassword = false,
    TextInputType? keyboardType,
  }) {
    final primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final textColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.white
        : (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87);

    return TextField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: isPassword,
      keyboardType: keyboardType,
      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(color: textColor),
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        labelStyle: accessibility.getTextStyle(color: primaryColor),
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: primaryColor),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: primaryColor, width: 2),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

================
File: lib/screens/chat_screen.dart

// lib/screens/chat_screen.dart

import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:file_picker/file_picker.dart';
import 'package:speech_to_text/speech_to_text.dart' as stt;
import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown_plus/flutter_markdown_plus.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

import '../models/subject.dart';
import '../providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import '../services/gemini_service.dart';
import '../services/pdf_export_service.dart';
import '../services/chat_service.dart';
import '../widgets/sign_language_interpreter.dart';
import 'main_navigation_screen.dart';

class ChatScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final Subject? subject;

  const ChatScreen({super.key, this.subject});

  @override
  State<ChatScreen> createState() => _ChatScreenState();
}

class _ChatScreenState extends State<ChatScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _controller = TextEditingController();
  final FlutterTts _flutterTts = FlutterTts();
  final GeminiService _geminiService = GeminiService();
  final ChatService _chatService = ChatService();
  final ImagePicker _imagePicker = ImagePicker();
  final stt.SpeechToText _speech = stt.SpeechToText();

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _messages = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _subjectMaterials = [];
  bool _isLoading = false;
  bool _isLoadingMaterials = false;
  bool _isListening = false;
  bool _speechInitialized = false;
  String? _activeChatId;

  Uint8List? _attachedBytes;
  String? _attachedMimeType;
  String? _attachedFileName;

  Subject get _activeSubject =>
      widget.subject ??
      Subject(
        id: 'general',
        name: 'General',
        iconCode: Icons.chat.codePoint,
        colorValue: Colors.teal.value,
        description: 'Consultas generales',
      );

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initTts();
    _initSpeech();
    _setupChatSession();
    _fetchSubjectMaterials();
  }

  /// Carga los materiales subidos por los docentes para esta materia específica
  Future<void> _fetchSubjectMaterials() async {
    if (_activeSubject.id == 'general' ||
        _activeSubject.id == '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') {
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoadingMaterials = true);

    try {
      final response = await Supabase.instance.client
          .from('study_materials')
          .select('*')
          .eq('subject_id', _activeSubject.id)
          .order('created_at', ascending: false);

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _subjectMaterials = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(response);
          _isLoadingMaterials = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error al cargar materiales de la materia: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoadingMaterials = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _initTts() async {
    await _flutterTts.setLanguage("es-ES");
    await _flutterTts.setPitch(1.0);
    await _flutterTts.setSpeechRate(0.5);
  }

  void _initSpeech() async {
    _speechInitialized = await _speech.initialize(
      onError: (error) => setState(() => _isListening = false),
      onStatus: (status) {
        if (status == 'done' || status == 'notListening') {
          setState(() => _isListening = false);
        }
      },
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _setupChatSession() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    _activeChatId = await _chatService.getOrCreateChat(_activeSubject.id);

    if (_activeChatId != null) {
      final loadedMessages = await _chatService.loadMessages(_activeChatId!);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _messages = loadedMessages;
        });
      }
    }

    if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
  }

  Future<void> _clearChatHistory() async {
    if (_activeChatId != null) {
      await _chatService.clearChat(_activeChatId!);
    }
    setState(() {
      _messages.clear();
    });
  }

  void _listenVoice() async {
    var status = await Permission.microphone.status;

    if (status.isDenied) {
      status = await Permission.microphone.request();
    }

    if (status.isPermanentlyDenied) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: const Text(
              'El permiso de micrófono está desactivado en los ajustes.'),
          action: SnackBarAction(
            label: 'Ajustes',
            onPressed: () => openAppSettings(),
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (status.isGranted) {
      if (!_speechInitialized) {
        _speechInitialized = await _speech.initialize(
          onError: (error) => setState(() => _isListening = false),
          onStatus: (status) {
            if (status == 'done' || status == 'notListening') {
              setState(() => _isListening = false);
            }
          },
        );
      }

      if (_speechInitialized) {
        if (!_isListening) {
          setState(() => _isListening = true);
          await _speech.listen(
            localeId: "es_ES",
            onResult: (result) {
              setState(() {
                _controller.text = result.recognizedWords;
              });
            },
          );
        } else {
          await _speech.stop();
          setState(() => _isListening = false);
        }
      }
    } else {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content:
              Text('Se requiere permiso de micrófono para usar esta función.'),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _speak(String text) async {
    final accessibility =
        Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context, listen: false);
    await _flutterTts.stop();
    await _flutterTts.setSpeechRate(accessibility.speechRate);
    if (text.isNotEmpty) {
      await _flutterTts.speak(text);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickImage(ImageSource source) async {
    final XFile? image = await _imagePicker.pickImage(source: source);
    if (image != null) {
      final bytes = await image.readAsBytes();
      final mime = image.mimeType ??
          (image.path.endsWith('.png') ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg');
      setState(() {
        _attachedBytes = bytes;
        _attachedMimeType = mime;
        _attachedFileName = image.name;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickDocument() async {
    FilePickerResult? result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
      type: FileType.custom,
      allowedExtensions: ['pdf', 'txt'],
      withData: true,
    );

    if (result != null && result.files.single.bytes != null) {
      final file = result.files.single;
      String mime = 'application/pdf';
      if (file.extension == 'txt') mime = 'text/plain';

      setState(() {
        _attachedBytes = file.bytes;
        _attachedMimeType = mime;
        _attachedFileName = file.name;
      });
    }
  }

  void _clearAttachment() {
    setState(() {
      _attachedBytes = null;
      _attachedMimeType = null;
      _attachedFileName = null;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _sendMessage() async {
    final text = _controller.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty && _attachedBytes == null) return;

    if (_isListening) {
      await _speech.stop();
      setState(() => _isListening = false);
    }

    final accessibility =
        Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context, listen: false);

    final sentAttachmentName = _attachedFileName;
    final bytesToSend = _attachedBytes;
    final mimeToSend = _attachedMimeType;

    setState(() {
      _messages.add({
        "role": "user",
        "text": text,
        "fileName": sentAttachmentName,
        "bytes": bytesToSend,
        "mimeType": mimeToSend,
      });
      _isLoading = true;
      _controller.clear();
    });

    _clearAttachment();

    if (_activeChatId != null && text.isNotEmpty) {
      await _chatService.saveMessage(
        chatId: _activeChatId!,
        sender: 'user',
        content: text,
      );
    }

    final response = await _geminiService.sendMessageWithHistory(
      messagesHistory: _messages,
      isTeaMode: accessibility.isTeaMode,
    );

    setState(() {
      _messages.add({"role": "ai", "text": response});
      _isLoading = false;
    });

    if (_activeChatId != null) {
      await _chatService.saveMessage(
        chatId: _activeChatId!,
        sender: 'ai',
        content: response,
      );
    }

    if (accessibility.autoReadText) {
      _speak(response);
    }
  }

  void _showAttachmentModal() {
    final primaryColor =
        Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context, listen: false)
            .activePrimaryColor;

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(Icons.camera_alt, color: primaryColor),
              title: const Text('Tomar Foto'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.pop(context);
                _pickImage(ImageSource.camera);
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(Icons.photo_library, color: primaryColor),
              title: const Text('Elegir de Galería'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.pop(context);
                _pickImage(ImageSource.gallery);
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf, color: primaryColor),
              title: const Text('Adjuntar Documento (PDF/TXT)'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.pop(context);
                _pickDocument();
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _flutterTts.stop();
    _speech.stop();
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accessibility = Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context);
    final primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back),
          tooltip: 'Volver',
          onPressed: () {
            if (Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
            } else {
              Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
                MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (context) => const MainNavigationScreen(),
                ),
                (route) => false,
              );
            }
          },
        ),
        backgroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.black : primaryColor,
        foregroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.yellowAccent : Colors.white,
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              _activeSubject.icon,
              color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                  ? Colors.yellowAccent
                  : Colors.white,
              size: 22,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                _activeSubject.name,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                  overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.0,
                  color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                      ? Colors.yellowAccent
                      : Colors.white,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf),
            tooltip: 'Exportar a PDF',
            onPressed: _messages.isEmpty
                ? null
                : () => PdfExportService.exportChatToPdf(_messages),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(
              accessibility.isTeaMode
                  ? Icons.psychology
                  : Icons.psychology_outlined,
              color: accessibility.isTeaMode
                  ? (accessibility.isHighContrast
                      ? Colors.yellowAccent
                      : Colors.white)
                  : null,
            ),
            tooltip: 'Alternar Modo TEA',
            onPressed: () =>
                accessibility.toggleTeaMode(!accessibility.isTeaMode),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
            tooltip: 'Borrar historial',
            onPressed: () {
              showDialog(
                context: context,
                builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
                  title: const Text('Borrar Conversación'),
                  content: Text(
                      '¿Deseas vaciar el historial de ${_activeSubject.id == "general" ? "Chat General" : _activeSubject.name}?'),
                  actions: [
                    TextButton(
                      child: const Text('Cancelar'),
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                    ),
                    TextButton(
                      child: const Text('Borrar',
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                      onPressed: () {
                        _clearChatHistory();
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          Column(
            children: [
              // Sección Desplegable de Materiales del Profesor
              if (_activeSubject.id != 'general' &&
                  _activeSubject.id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
                Container(
                  color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E232A) : Colors.teal.shade50,
                  child: ExpansionTile(
                    tilePadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                    leading:
                        const Icon(Icons.folder_outlined, color: Colors.teal),
                    title: Text(
                      'Guías y trabajos del Profesor (${_subjectMaterials.length})',
                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                        overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.85,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.teal.shade900,
                      ),
                    ),
                    children: _isLoadingMaterials
                        ? [
                            const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
                              child: Center(
                                child:
                                    CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                              ),
                            )
                          ]
                        : _subjectMaterials.isEmpty
                            ? [
                                Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
                                  child: Text(
                                    'No hay materiales de estudio subidos para esta materia.',
                                    style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                      overrideSize:
                                          accessibility.fontSize * 0.8,
                                      color: isDark
                                          ? Colors.white70
                                          : Colors.black54,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                )
                              ]
                            : _subjectMaterials.map((mat) {
                                final title =
                                    mat['title'] ?? 'Material de clase';
                                final desc = mat['description'] ?? '';
                                final fileUrl = mat['file_url'] ??
                                    mat['url'] ??
                                    mat['file_path'];

                                return Container(
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    border: Border(
                                      top: BorderSide(
                                        color: isDark
                                            ? Colors.white12
                                            : Colors.teal.shade100,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: ListTile(
                                    dense: true,
                                    leading: const Icon(Icons.menu_book,
                                        color: Colors.teal, size: 20),
                                    title: Text(
                                      title,
                                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                        overrideSize:
                                            accessibility.fontSize * 0.85,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    subtitle: desc.isNotEmpty
                                        ? Text(
                                            desc,
                                            maxLines: 2,
                                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                              overrideSize:
                                                  accessibility.fontSize * 0.75,
                                              color: isDark
                                                  ? Colors.white70
                                                  : Colors.black54,
                                            ),
                                          )
                                        : null,
                                    trailing: ElevatedButton.icon(
                                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                        backgroundColor: Colors.teal,
                                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                            horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                                      ),
                                      icon: const Icon(Icons.help_outline,
                                          size: 16),
                                      label: const Text('Preguntar',
                                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                                      onPressed: () async {
                                        setState(() => _isLoading = true);

                                        Uint8List? downloadedBytes;
                                        String? mimeType;

                                        if (fileUrl != null &&
                                            fileUrl.toString().isNotEmpty) {
                                          try {
                                            final res = await http.get(
                                                Uri.parse(fileUrl.toString()));
                                            if (res.statusCode == 200) {
                                              downloadedBytes = res.bodyBytes;
                                              mimeType = 'application/pdf';
                                            }
                                          } catch (e) {
                                            debugPrint(
                                                'Error al descargar el PDF: $e');
                                          }
                                        }

                                        if (mounted) {
                                          setState(() {
                                            _attachedBytes = downloadedBytes;
                                            _attachedMimeType = mimeType;
                                            _attachedFileName = '$title.pdf';
                                            _controller.text = desc.isNotEmpty
                                                ? 'Lee detenidamente el PDF adjunto ("$title"). Consigna: "$desc". ¿De qué trata y por dónde empezamos?'
                                                : 'Lee detenidamente el PDF adjunto ("$title"). ¿De qué trata y por dónde empezamos?';
                                            _isLoading = false;
                                          });

                                          await _sendMessage();
                                        }
                                      },
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }).toList(),
                  ),
                ),

              Expanded(
                child: ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  itemCount: _messages.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final msg = _messages[index];
                    final isUser = msg["role"] == "user";

                    final bubbleBg = isUser
                        ? (accessibility.isHighContrast
                            ? Colors.yellowAccent
                            : (accessibility.isTeaMode
                                ? Colors.teal.shade300
                                : primaryColor))
                        : (accessibility.isHighContrast
                            ? Colors.grey.shade900
                            : (isDark
                                ? const Color(0xFF222831)
                                : Colors.grey.shade200));

                    final userTextColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
                        ? Colors.black
                        : (bubbleBg.computeLuminance() > 0.5
                            ? Colors.black87
                            : Colors.white);

                    final aiTextColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
                        ? Colors.white
                        : (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87);

                    final msgTextColor = isUser ? userTextColor : aiTextColor;

                    return Align(
                      alignment:
                          isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
                      child: Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                        constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxWidth: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.85,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: bubbleBg,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            if (msg["bytes"] != null &&
                                msg["mimeType"] != null) ...[
                              if (msg["mimeType"]
                                  .toString()
                                  .startsWith("image/"))
                                Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8.0),
                                  child: ClipRRect(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                    child: Image.memory(
                                      msg["bytes"] as Uint8List,
                                      height: 220,
                                      width: double.infinity,
                                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                )
                              else ...[
                                Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: Colors.white24,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  ),
                                  child: Row(
                                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                    children: [
                                      const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf,
                                          color: Colors.red, size: 28),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                      Flexible(
                                        child: Text(
                                          msg["fileName"] ??
                                              "Documento adjunto",
                                          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                            overrideSize:
                                                accessibility.fontSize * 0.85,
                                            color: msgTextColor,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                              ],
                            ],
                            if ((msg["text"] ?? "").isNotEmpty)
                              MarkdownBody(
                                data: msg["text"],
                                selectable: true,
                                styleSheet: MarkdownStyleSheet.fromTheme(
                                        Theme.of(context))
                                    .copyWith(
                                  p: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                      color: msgTextColor),
                                  strong: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                      color: msgTextColor,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                                  em: accessibility
                                      .getTextStyle(color: msgTextColor)
                                      .copyWith(fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                                  code: accessibility
                                      .getTextStyle(color: msgTextColor)
                                      .copyWith(
                                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                        backgroundColor:
                                            const Color(0x22000000),
                                      ),
                                  codeblockPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                  codeblockDecoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: const Color(0x11000000),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            if (!isUser) ...[
                              const SizedBox(height: 8),
                              IconButton(
                                icon: Icon(
                                  Icons.volume_up,
                                  size: 22,
                                  color:
                                      isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black54,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () => _speak(msg["text"] ?? ""),
                              ),
                            ]
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              if (_isLoading) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
              if (_attachedFileName != null && _attachedBytes != null)
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  margin:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color:
                        isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E2E2E) : Colors.teal.shade50,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(
                        color: isDark
                            ? Colors.teal.shade700
                            : Colors.teal.shade200),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      if (_attachedMimeType != null &&
                          _attachedMimeType!.startsWith('image/'))
                        ClipRRect(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          child: Image.memory(
                            _attachedBytes!,
                            width: 55,
                            height: 55,
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          ),
                        )
                      else
                        Container(
                          width: 55,
                          height: 55,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.red.shade100,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          ),
                          child: const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf,
                              color: Colors.red, size: 32),
                        ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              _attachedFileName!,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.85,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text(
                              _attachedMimeType?.startsWith('image/') == true
                                  ? 'Vista previa de imagen'
                                  : 'Documento adjunto',
                              style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.75,
                                color: isDark
                                    ? Colors.white70
                                    : Colors.grey.shade700,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.cancel, color: Colors.grey),
                        onPressed: _clearAttachment,
                      )
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E232A) : Colors.white,
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline,
                          color: primaryColor, size: 28),
                      onPressed: _showAttachmentModal,
                    ),
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _controller,
                        style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                          color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                        ),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: _isListening
                              ? 'Escuchando tu voz...'
                              : 'Escribe o habla tu duda...',
                          hintStyle: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                            color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : Colors.black38,
                          ),
                          border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(
                        _isListening ? Icons.mic : Icons.mic_none,
                        color: _isListening ? Colors.red : primaryColor,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      tooltip: 'Hablar',
                      onPressed: _listenVoice,
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(Icons.send, color: primaryColor, size: 28),
                      onPressed: _sendMessage,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (accessibility.isSignLanguageEnabled)
            Positioned(
              right: 16,
              bottom: 80,
              child: SignLanguageInterpreter(
                textToInterpret:
                    _messages.isNotEmpty && _messages.last["role"] == "ai"
                        ? (_messages.last["text"] ?? "")
                        : "",
                isLoading: _isLoading,
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

File: lib/screens/main_navigation_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/psico_auth.dart';
import 'subjects_screen.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';

class MainNavigationScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MainNavigationScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<MainNavigationScreen> createState() => _MainNavigationScreenState();
}

class _MainNavigationScreenState extends State<MainNavigationScreen> {
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _isSettingsUnlocked = false;

  final List<Widget> _screens = const [
    SubjectsScreen(),
    SettingsScreen(),
  ];

  Future<void> _handleTabSelection(int index) async {
    if (index == 1 && !_isSettingsUnlocked) {
      final authenticated = await PsicoAuth.showDialogGate(context);
      if (authenticated && mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isSettingsUnlocked = true;
          _currentIndex = index;
        });
      }
    } else {
      setState(() => _currentIndex = index);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: IndexedStack(
        index: _currentIndex,
        children: _screens,
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: _currentIndex,
        onDestinationSelected: _handleTabSelection,
        destinations: const [
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.school_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.school, color: Colors.teal),
            label: 'Materias',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.settings, color: Colors.teal),
            label: 'Ajustes',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
