import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import '../theme/app_colors.dart';
import 'auth_screen.dart';
import 'main_navigation_screen.dart';
import 'teacher_panel_screen.dart'; // Importante

class OnboardingScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnboardingScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<OnboardingScreen> createState() => _OnboardingScreenState();
}

class _OnboardingScreenState extends State<OnboardingScreen> {
  final PageController _pageController = PageController();
  int _currentPage = 0;
  String _selectedRole = 'Estudiante';

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _roles = [
    {
      'id': 'Estudiante',
      'title': 'Estudiante / Alumno',
      'icon': Icons.school_rounded,
      'description': 'Aprende y realiza consultas adaptadas con el Tutor IA.',
    },
    {
      'id': 'Referente Afectivo',
      'title': 'Referente Afectivo',
      'icon': Icons.favorite_rounded,
      'description':
          'Familia o acompañante que brinda apoyo afectivo y seguimiento.',
    },
    {
      'id': 'Docente',
      'title': 'Docente / Profesor',
      'icon': Icons.assignment_ind_rounded,
      'description': 'Diseña actividades y realiza seguimiento pedagógico.',
    },
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _nextPage() {
    if (_currentPage < 2) {
      _pageController.nextPage(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
      );
    } else {
      _completeOnboarding();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _completeOnboarding() async {
    final userProvider = Provider.of<UserProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final bool isLoggedIn =
        Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession != null;

    if (isLoggedIn) {
      await userProvider.setRoleAndCompleteOnboarding(_selectedRole);
    } else {
      await userProvider.setRole(_selectedRole);
    }

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool('onboarding_completed', true);

    if (!mounted) return;

    Widget targetScreen;
    if (isLoggedIn) {
      if (_selectedRole.toLowerCase() == 'docente') {
        targetScreen = const TeacherPanelScreen();
      } else {
        targetScreen = const MainNavigationScreen();
      }
    } else {
      targetScreen = const AuthScreen();
    }

    Navigator.pushReplacement(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => targetScreen),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accessibility = Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context);
    final primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;

    final Color bgColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.black
        : Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor;
    final Color textColor =
        accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.yellowAccent : AppColors.darkBlue;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bgColor,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.black : primaryColor,
        elevation: 0,
        title: Text(
          'Configuración Inicial',
          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
            overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
            color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                ? Colors.yellowAccent
                : Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          // --- BARRA DE PASOS ---
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 16),
            child: Row(
              children: List.generate(3, (index) {
                return Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
                    height: 8,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: index <= _currentPage
                          ? (accessibility.isHighContrast
                              ? Colors.yellowAccent
                              : primaryColor)
                          : Colors.grey.shade300,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ),
          ),

          // --- VISTAS SLIDER ---
          Expanded(
            child: PageView(
              controller: _pageController,
              onPageChanged: (page) => setState(() => _currentPage = page),
              children: [
                _buildRoleSelectionPage(accessibility, primaryColor, textColor),
                _buildAccessibilityPage(accessibility, primaryColor, textColor),
                _buildSummaryPage(accessibility, primaryColor, textColor),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // --- BOTÓN CONTINUAR ---
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
            child: SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 55,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  ),
                ),
                onPressed: _nextPage,
                child: Text(
                  _currentPage == 2 ? 'Comenzar Experiencia' : 'Siguiente',
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                    color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                        ? Colors.black
                        : Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // PASO 1: SELECCIÓN DE ROL
  Widget _buildRoleSelectionPage(
    AccessibilityProvider accessibility,
    Color primaryColor,
    Color textColor,
  ) {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            '¡Bienvenido/a a EduInclusiva!',
            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
              overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.3,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: textColor,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            'Selecciona tu perfil o rol en la plataforma:',
            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
              overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.9,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          ..._roles.map((role) {
            final isSelected = _selectedRole == role['id'];
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                    ? Colors.grey.shade900
                    : (isSelected
                        ? primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1)
                        : Colors.white),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: isSelected
                      ? primaryColor
                      : (accessibility.isHighContrast
                          ? Colors.grey.shade700
                          : Colors.grey.shade300),
                  width: isSelected ? 2.5 : 1,
                ),
              ),
              child: ListTile(
                contentPadding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                leading: CircleAvatar(
                  backgroundColor: isSelected
                      ? primaryColor
                      : primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                  child: Icon(
                    role['icon'],
                    color: isSelected
                        ? Colors.white
                        : (accessibility.isHighContrast
                            ? Colors.yellowAccent
                            : primaryColor),
                  ),
                ),
                title: Text(
                  role['title'],
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.95,
                  ),
                ),
                subtitle: Text(
                  role['description'],
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                    overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
                trailing: isSelected
                    ? Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: primaryColor)
                    : null,
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _selectedRole = role['id']);
                },
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // PASO 2: AJUSTES DE ACCESIBILIDAD
  Widget _buildAccessibilityPage(

            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(

              color: textColor,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            'Personaliza la app según tus preferencias de lectura y asistencia:',
            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
              overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.85,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Card(
            elevation: 1,
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
            child: SwitchListTile(
              value: accessibility.isTeaMode,
              title: Text('Modo TEA / Neurodivergente',
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.9)),
              subtitle: Text(
                  'Respuestas estructuradas y menor sobrecarga cognitiva.',

                      overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.8)),

File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import 'auth_screen.dart';

class ProfileScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ProfileScreen> createState() => _ProfileScreenState();
}

class _ProfileScreenState extends State<ProfileScreen> {
  final _supabase = Supabase.instance.client;
  late TextEditingController _nameController;
  late TextEditingController _emailController;
  bool _isSaving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final userProvider = Provider.of<UserProvider>(context, listen: false);
    _nameController = TextEditingController(text: userProvider.name);
    _emailController = TextEditingController(text: userProvider.email);
    _loadProfileFromSupabase();
  }

  Future<void> _loadProfileFromSupabase() async {
    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;

    try {
      final profile = await _supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select()
          .eq('id', user.id)
          .maybeSingle();

      if (profile != null && mounted) {
        setState(() {
          if (profile['name'] != null &&
              profile['name'].toString().isNotEmpty) {
            _nameController.text = profile['name'];
          }
          if (user.email != null) {
            _emailController.text = user.email!;
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _emailController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  ImageProvider? _getProfileImage(String path) {
    if (path.isEmpty) return null;
    if (path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://')) {
      return NetworkImage(path);
    }
    final file = File(path);
    if (file.existsSync()) {
      return FileImage(file);
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _saveProfileChanges(UserProvider userProvider) async {
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);
    final user = _supabase.auth.currentUser;

    try {
      final newName = _nameController.text.trim();
      userProvider.updateName(newName);
      userProvider.updateEmail(_emailController.text.trim());

      if (user != null) {
        await _supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
          'id': user.id,
          'name': newName,
        });
      }

      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Perfil actualizado correctamente')),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Error al guardar en Supabase: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accessibility = Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context);
    final userProvider = Provider.of<UserProvider>(context);
    final primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;

    final imageProvider = _getProfileImage(userProvider.profileImagePath);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: accessibility.isHighContrast
          ? Colors.black
          : Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          'Mi Perfil',
          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
            overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
            color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                ? Colors.yellowAccent
                : Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
        backgroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.black : primaryColor,
        foregroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.yellowAccent : Colors.white,
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () async {
                final picker = ImagePicker();
                final image =
                    await picker.pickImage(source: ImageSource.gallery);
                if (image != null) {
                  userProvider.updateProfileImage(image.path);
                }
              },
              child: Stack(
                alignment: Alignment.bottomRight,
                children: [
                  imageProvider == null
                      ? userProvider.getDefaultAvatar(
                          radius: 60, color: primaryColor)
                      : CircleAvatar(
                          radius: 60,
                          backgroundImage: imageProvider,
                        ),
                  CircleAvatar(
                    backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                    radius: 20,
                    child: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt,
                        color: Colors.white, size: 20),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 32),
            _buildCustomTextField(
              label: 'Nombre Completo',
              controller: _nameController,
              icon: Icons.person,
              accessibility: accessibility,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            _buildCustomTextField(
              label: 'Correo Electrónico',
              controller: _emailController,
              icon: Icons.email,
              accessibility: accessibility,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 32),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 55,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                ),
                onPressed:
                    _isSaving ? null : () => _saveProfileChanges(userProvider),
                child: _isSaving
                    ? const CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white)
                    : Text(
                        'Guardar Cambios',
                        style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                          color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                              ? Colors.black
                              : Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
                        ),
                      ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 55,
              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red, width: 2),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.logout, color: Colors.red),
                label: Text(
                  'Cerrar Sesión',
                  style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                    color: Colors.red,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.0,
                  ),
                ),
                onPressed: () async {
                  final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
                    context: context,
                    builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
                      title: const Text('Cerrar Sesión'),
                      content: const Text('¿Estás seguro de que deseas salir?'),
                      actions: [
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
                        ),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                          child: const Text('Salir',
                              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );

                  if (confirm == true && context.mounted) {
                    await _supabase.auth.signOut();
                    await userProvider.signOut();
                    if (!context.mounted) return;
                    Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
                      context,
                      MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
                      (route) => false,
                    );
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCustomTextField({
    required String label,
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required IconData icon,
    required AccessibilityProvider accessibility,
  }) {
    final primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;
    return TextField(
      controller: controller,
      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(),
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        labelStyle: accessibility.getTextStyle(color: primaryColor),
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: primaryColor),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: primaryColor, width: 2),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

================
File: lib/screens/psico_panel_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown_plus/flutter_markdown_plus.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import 'auth_screen.dart';

String _fmtDate(String? iso) {
  if (iso == null) return '';
  final d = DateTime.tryParse(iso)?.toLocal();
  if (d == null) return '';
  String two(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
  return '${two(d.day)}/${two(d.month)}/${d.year} ${two(d.hour)}:${two(d.minute)}';
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1) Lista de alumnos
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class PsicoPanelScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PsicoPanelScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<PsicoPanelScreen> createState() => _PsicoPanelScreenState();
}

class _PsicoPanelScreenState extends State<PsicoPanelScreen> {
  final _search = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _students = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final data = await Supabase.instance.client
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id, name, email, role')
          .order('name');
      if (!mounted) return;
      final all = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(data);
      setState(() {
        _students = all
            .where((p) =>
                (p['role'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() != 'psicopedagoga')
            .toList();
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'No se pudo cargar la lista de alumnos.';
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    await context.read<UserProvider>().signOut();
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const AuthScreen()),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final q = _search.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    final filtered = _students.where((s) {
      final name = (s['name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final email = (s['email'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      return q.isEmpty || name.contains(q) || email.contains(q);
    }).toList();

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Panel de psicopedagogía'),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Actualizar',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            onPressed: _load,
          ),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Cerrar sesión',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.logout),
            onPressed: _logout,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: TextField(
              controller: _search,
              onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Buscar por nombre o correo',
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: _loading
                ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                : _error != null
                    ? Center(child: Text(_error!))
                    : filtered.isEmpty
                        ? const Center(
                            child: Text('No hay alumnos para mostrar.'))
                        : RefreshIndicator(
                            onRefresh: _load,
                            child: ListView.separated(
                              itemCount: filtered.length,
                              separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                  const Divider(height: 1),
                              itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                                final s = filtered[i];
                                final name =
                                    (s['name'] ?? 'Sin nombre').toString();
                                return ListTile(
                                  leading: CircleAvatar(
                                    child: Text(name.isNotEmpty
                                        ? name[0].toUpperCase()
                                        : '?'),
                                  ),
                                  title: Text(name),
                                  subtitle: Text((s['email'] ?? '').toString()),
                                  trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                                  onTap: () => Navigator.push(
                                    context,
                                    MaterialPageRoute(
                                      builder: (_) => StudentChatsScreen(
                                        studentId: s['id'] as String,
                                        studentName: name,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2) Chats de un alumno
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class StudentChatsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String studentId;
  final String studentName;

  const StudentChatsScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.studentId,
    required this.studentName,
  });

  @override
  State<StudentChatsScreen> createState() => _StudentChatsScreenState();
}

class _StudentChatsScreenState extends State<StudentChatsScreen> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _chats = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final data = await Supabase.instance.client
          .from('chats')
          .select('id, title, subject_id, created_at, updated_at')
          .eq('user_id', widget.studentId)
          .order('updated_at', ascending: false);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _chats = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(data);
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'No se pudieron cargar los chats.';
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.studentName)),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : _error != null
              ? Center(child: Text(_error!))
              : _chats.isEmpty
                  ? const Center(
                      child: Text('Este alumno todavía no tiene chats.'))
                  : ListView.separated(
                      itemCount: _chats.length,
                      separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const Divider(height: 1),
                      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                        final c = _chats[i];
                        final title = (c['title'] ?? '').toString();
                        final subject = (c['subject_id'] ?? '').toString();
                        return ListTile(
                          leading: const Icon(Icons.chat_bubble_outline),
                          title:
                              Text(title.isEmpty ? 'Chat sin título' : title),
                          subtitle: Text(
                              '$subject · ${_fmtDate(c['updated_at'] as String?)}'),
                          trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                          onTap: () => Navigator.push(
                            context,
                            MaterialPageRoute(
                              builder: (_) => ChatMessagesScreen(
                                chatId: c['id'] as String,
                                title: title.isEmpty ? 'Chat' : title,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3) Conversación completa (solo lectura)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ChatMessagesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String chatId;
  final String title;

  const ChatMessagesScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.chatId,
    required this.title,
  });

  @override
  State<ChatMessagesScreen> createState() => _ChatMessagesScreenState();
}

class _ChatMessagesScreenState extends State<ChatMessagesScreen> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _messages = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final data = await Supabase.instance.client
          .from('messages')
          .select('sender, content, created_at')
          .eq('chat_id', widget.chatId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _messages = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(data);
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'No se pudo cargar la conversación.';
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar:
          AppBar(title: Text(widget.title, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : _error != null
              ? Center(child: Text(_error!))
              : _messages.isEmpty
                  ? const Center(child: Text('Esta conversación está vacía.'))
                  : ListView.builder(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      itemCount: _messages.length,
                      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                        final m = _messages[i];
                        final isStudent = m['sender'] == 'user';
                        final content = (m['content'] ?? '').toString();

                        return Align(
                          alignment: isStudent
                              ? Alignment.centerRight
                              : Alignment.centerLeft,
                          child: Container(
                            constraints: BoxConstraints(
                              maxWidth:
                                  MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.85,
                            ),
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isStudent
                                  ? scheme.primaryContainer
                                  : scheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  isStudent ? 'Alumno' : 'Tutor IA',
                                  style: Theme.of(context)
                                      .textTheme
                                      .labelSmall
                                      ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                isStudent
                                    ? SelectableText(content)
                                    : MarkdownBody(
                                        data: content, selectable: true),
                                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                Text(
                                  _fmtDate(m['created_at'] as String?),
                                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall,
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';

class ReaderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReaderScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ReaderScreen> createState() => _ReaderScreenState();
}

class _ReaderScreenState extends State<ReaderScreen> {
  final FlutterTts _tts = FlutterTts();
  final TextEditingController _textController = TextEditingController(
    text: 'EduInclusiva IA adapta los contenidos escolares para que todos los estudiantes aprendan a su propio ritmo con apoyo auditivo y visual.',
  );
  bool _isSpeaking = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initTts();
  }

  Future<void> _initTts() async {
    await _tts.setLanguage("es-ES");
    await _tts.setPitch(1.0);
    await _tts.setSpeechRate(
      0.45,
    ); // Tasa pausada para facilitar la comprensión

    _tts.setCompletionHandler(() {
      setState(() => _isSpeaking = false);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _speak() async {
    if (_textController.text.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() => _isSpeaking = true);
      await _tts.speak(_textController.text);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _stop() async {
    await _tts.stop();
    setState(() => _isSpeaking = false);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tts.stop();
    _textController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Lectura Fácil y Voz'),
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Texto para Adaptar / Leer:',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: _textController,
              maxLines: 6,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, height: 1.5),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                ),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: Colors.white,
                hintText: 'Ingresa o pega un texto aquí...',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _isSpeaking ? _stop : _speak,
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                      backgroundColor: _isSpeaking
                          ? Colors.redAccent
                          : const Color(0xFF0D47A1),
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      ),
                    ),
                    icon: Icon(
                      _isSpeaking ? Icons.stop : Icons.volume_up,
                      size: 28,
                    ),
                    label: Text(
                      _isSpeaking ? 'Detener' : 'Escuchar Texto',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import '../theme/app_colors.dart';
import 'auth_screen.dart';
import 'onboarding_screen.dart';

class SettingsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({super.key});

  Future<void> _resetOnboarding(BuildContext context) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool('onboarding_completed', false);
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacement(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const OnboardingScreen()),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _signOut(
    BuildContext context,
    AccessibilityProvider accessibility,
    Color primaryColor,
  ) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          'Cerrar sesión',
          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        content: Text(
          '¿Seguro que quieres cerrar tu sesión?',
          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: Text('Cancelar', style: accessibility.getTextStyle()),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: Text(
              'Cerrar sesión',
              style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                color: primaryColor,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;
    if (!context.mounted) return;

    await context.read<UserProvider>().signOut();
    if (!context.mounted) return;

    Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const AuthScreen()),
      (route) => false,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accessibility = Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context);

    // Solo mostramos "Cerrar sesión" si hay una sesión activa
    final bool hasSession =
        Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession != null;

    final List<Color> themePalette = [
      AppColors.darkBlue,
      AppColors.periwinkle,
      AppColors.mint,
      AppColors.warmYellow,
      AppColors.lightBlue,
      const Color(0xFFE892A8),
    ];

    final Color bgColor =
        accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.black : AppColors.background;
    final Color cardColor =
        accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.grey.shade900 : Colors.white;
    final Color textColor =
        accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkBlue;

    final Color primaryColor = accessibility.isColorBlindMode
        ? Colors.blue.shade700
        : (accessibility.isHighContrast
            ? Colors.yellowAccent
            : accessibility.customColor);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bgColor,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          'Configuración y Accesibilidad',
          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
            overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
            color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                ? Colors.yellowAccent
                : Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
        backgroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.black : primaryColor,
        foregroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.yellowAccent : Colors.white,
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        children: [
          // --- PERSONALIZACIÓN DE TEMA Y COLOR ---
          Text(
            'Tema y Color de Interfaz',
            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                overrideSize: 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: primaryColor),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Card(
            color: cardColor,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Modo de pantalla:',
                    style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                        color: textColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: SegmentedButton<ThemeMode>(
                      segments: const [
                        ButtonSegment(
                          value: ThemeMode.system,
                          label: Text('Sistema'),
                          icon: Icon(Icons.brightness_auto, size: 18),
                        ),
                        ButtonSegment(
                          value: ThemeMode.light,
                          label: Text('Claro'),
                          icon: Icon(Icons.light_mode, size: 18),
                        ),
                        ButtonSegment(
                          value: ThemeMode.dark,
                          label: Text('Oscuro'),
                          icon: Icon(Icons.dark_mode, size: 18),
                        ),
                      ],
                      selected: {accessibility.themeMode},
                      onSelectionChanged: (Set<ThemeMode> newSelection) {
                        accessibility.setThemeMode(newSelection.first);
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Divider(color: textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'Selecciona el color principal:',
                    style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                        color: textColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 12,
                    runSpacing: 12,
                    children: themePalette.map((color) {
                      final isSelected = accessibility.customColor.toARGB32() ==
                          color.toARGB32();
                      return InkWell(
                        onTap: () => accessibility.setCustomColor(color),
                        child: Container(
                          width: 44,
                          height: 44,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: color,
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,

                                ? Border.all(
                                    color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                        ? Colors.white
                                        : Colors.black87,
                                    width: 3)
                                : null,
                            boxShadow: isSelected
                                ? [
                                    BoxShadow(
                                      color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                                      blurRadius: 8,
                                      spreadRadius: 2,
                                    )
                                  ]
                                : [],
                          ),
                          child: isSelected
                              ? const Icon(Icons.check, color: Colors.white)
                              : null,
                        ),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),

          // --- VISIÓN ---
          Text(
            'Visión',
            style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                overrideSize: 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: primaryColor),
          ),
          Card(
            color: cardColor,
            child: Column(
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'Tamaño del texto: ${accessibility.fontSize.round()}',
                        style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                            color: textColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                      ),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.text_fields, size: 16, color: textColor),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Slider(
                              value: accessibility.fontSize,
                              min: 14.0,
                              max: 36.0,
                              divisions: 11,
                              activeColor: primaryColor,
                              onChanged: (val) =>
                                  accessibility.setFontSize(val),
                            ),
                          ),
                          Icon(Icons.text_fields, size: 32, color: textColor),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                SwitchListTile(
                  title: Text('Alto Contraste',
                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(color: textColor)),
                  subtitle: Text('Fondo oscuro y colores brillantes',
                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                          overrideSize: 12,
                          color: textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7))),
                  value: accessibility.isHighContrast,
                  activeThumbColor: primaryColor,
                  onChanged: (val) => accessibility.toggleHighContrast(val),
                ),
                SwitchListTile(
                  title: Text('Modo Daltonismo',
                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(color: textColor)),
                  subtitle: Text('Ajusta colores para mejor distinción',
                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                          overrideSize: 12,
                          color: textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7))),
                  value: accessibility.isColorBlindMode,
                  activeThumbColor: primaryColor,
                  onChanged: (val) => accessibility.toggleColorBlindMode(val),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),

          // --- COGNITIVO Y NEURODIVERGENCIA ---

================
File: lib/screens/splash_screen.dart
================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import '../theme/app_colors.dart';
import 'auth_screen.dart';
import 'main_navigation_screen.dart';
import 'onboarding_screen.dart';
import 'psico_panel_screen.dart';
import 'teacher_panel_screen.dart'; // Importante

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _startAppFlow();
  }

  Future<void> _startAppFlow() async {
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2500));

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final bool localOnboardingDone =
        prefs.getBool('onboarding_completed') ?? false;

    final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
    final bool isLoggedIn = session != null;

    if (!mounted) return;

    Widget nextScreen;

    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      nextScreen =
          localOnboardingDone ? const AuthScreen() : const OnboardingScreen();
    } else {
      final userProvider = context.read<UserProvider>();
      await userProvider.loadFromSupabase();
      if (!mounted) return;

      final role = userProvider.role.toLowerCase();

      if (role == 'psicopedagoga') {
        nextScreen = const PsicoPanelScreen();
      } else if (role == 'docente') {
        nextScreen = const TeacherPanelScreen();
      } else if (!userProvider.onboardingCompleted) {
        nextScreen = const OnboardingScreen();
      } else {
        nextScreen = const MainNavigationScreen();
      }
    }

    Navigator.pushReplacement(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => nextScreen),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      body: Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Image.asset(
              'assets/logo.png',
              width: 240,
              fit: BoxFit.contain,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            const CircularProgressIndicator(
              valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(AppColors.darkBlue),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/subjects_screen.dart

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../models/subject.dart';
import '../providers/subject_provider.dart';
import '../providers/accessibility_provider.dart';
import '../providers/user_provider.dart';
import '../theme/app_colors.dart';
import 'chat_screen.dart';
import 'profile_screen.dart';

class SubjectsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const SubjectsScreen({super.key});

  void _showAddSubjectDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final nameController = TextEditingController();
    final descController = TextEditingController();
    final yearController = TextEditingController();
    final divisionController = TextEditingController();

    Color selectedColor = AppColors.periwinkle;
    IconData selectedIcon = Icons.school;

    final primaryColor =
        Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context, listen: false)
            .activePrimaryColor;

    final availableIcons = [
      Icons.school,
      Icons.music_note,
      Icons.palette,
      Icons.computer,
      Icons.fitness_center,
      Icons.psychology,
      Icons.architecture,
      Icons.biotech,
    ];

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setStateModal) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
          title: Text(
            'Añadir Nueva Asignatura',
            style: TextStyle(color: primaryColor),
          ),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                TextField(
                  controller: nameController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Nombre de la Materia',
                    hintText: 'Ej. Robótica, Filosofía',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: yearController,
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          labelText: 'Año',
                          hintText: 'Ej. 1°',
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: divisionController,
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          labelText: 'División',
                          hintText: 'Ej. A',
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: descController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Descripción corta',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                const Align(
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Text('Elige un Ícono:',
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: availableIcons.map((icon) {
                    final isSelected = selectedIcon == icon;
                    return InkWell(
                      onTap: () => setStateModal(() => selectedIcon = icon),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: isSelected
                              ? primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                              : Colors.grey.shade200,
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          border: isSelected
                              ? Border.all(color: primaryColor, width: 2)
                              : null,
                        ),
                        child: Icon(icon,
                            color: isSelected ? primaryColor : Colors.black87),
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: const Text('Cancelar'),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              ),
              onPressed: () async {
                final name = nameController.text.trim();
                if (name.isNotEmpty) {
                  final newSub = Subject(
                    id: '',
                    name: name,
                    year: yearController.text.trim(),
                    division: divisionController.text.trim(),
                    iconCode: selectedIcon.codePoint,
                    colorValue: selectedColor.value,
                    description: descController.text.trim(),
                  );

                  try {
                    await Provider.of<SubjectProvider>(context, listen: false)
                        .addSubject(newSub);
                    if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  } catch (e) {
                    if (context.mounted) {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(content: Text('Error al guardar materia: $e')),
                      );
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              child: const Text('Guardar'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accessibility = Provider.of<AccessibilityProvider>(context);
    final subjectProvider = Provider.of<SubjectProvider>(context);
    final userProvider = Provider.of<UserProvider>(context);

    // Muestra el botón flotante únicamente para profesores o psicopedagogas
    final currentRole = userProvider.role.toLowerCase();
    final isTeacher =
        currentRole == 'docente' || currentRole == 'psicopedagoga';

    final Color primaryColor = accessibility.activePrimaryColor;

    final generalSubject = Subject(
      id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
      name: 'Chat General',
      iconCode: Icons.forum_rounded.codePoint,
      colorValue: primaryColor.value,
      description: 'Consultas generales libremente con el Tutor IA',
    );

    final Color bgColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.black
        : Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor;
    final Color cardColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.grey.shade900
        : primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.12);
    final Color textColor = accessibility.isHighContrast
        ? Colors.white
        : (Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
            ? Colors.white
            : AppColors.darkBlue);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bgColor,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.black : primaryColor,
        foregroundColor:
            accessibility.isHighContrast ? Colors.yellowAccent : Colors.white,
        title: Text(
          'Materias de Estudio',
          style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
            overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.1,
            color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                ? Colors.yellowAccent
                : Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: () {
              Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (context) => const ProfileScreen(),
                ),
              );
            },
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 16.0),
              child: Builder(
                builder: (_) {
                  final path = userProvider.profileImagePath;
                  ImageProvider? avatarImage;

                  if (path.isNotEmpty) {
                    if (path.startsWith('http')) {
                      avatarImage = NetworkImage(path);
                    } else {
                      final file = File(path);
                      if (file.existsSync()) avatarImage = FileImage(file);
                    }
                  }

                  return avatarImage != null
                      ? CircleAvatar(
                          radius: 18,
                          backgroundImage: avatarImage,
                        )
                      : userProvider.getDefaultAvatar(
                          radius: 18,
                          color: Colors.white,
                        );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: () => subjectProvider.fetchSubjects(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                '¿Qué te gustaría estudiar hoy?',
                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                  overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.25,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: textColor,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                'Selecciona una asignatura o accede al chat libre:',
                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                  overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.85,
                  color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                      ? Colors.white70
                      : textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Card(
                color: cardColor,
                elevation: 2,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  side: BorderSide(
                      color: primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5), width: 1.5),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.push(
                      context,
                      MaterialPageRoute(
                        builder: (context) =>
                            ChatScreen(subject: generalSubject),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 16.0, vertical: 14.0),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        CircleAvatar(
                          radius: 24,
                          backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                          child: Icon(
                            Icons.forum_rounded,
                            color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                ? Colors.black
                                : Colors.white,
                            size: 26,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 14),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                'Chat General con Tutor IA',
                                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                  overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 1.0,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: textColor,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              Text(
                                'Haz consultas libres sobre cualquier tema.',
                                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                  overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.8,
                                  color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                      ? Colors.white70
                                      : textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        Icon(
                          Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                          color: primaryColor,
                          size: 18,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'Materias Registradas',
                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                  overrideSize: accessibility.fontSize * 0.95,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: primaryColor,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: subjectProvider.isLoading
                    ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                    : GridView.builder(
                        gridDelegate:
                            const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                          crossAxisCount: 2,
                          crossAxisSpacing: 12,
                          mainAxisSpacing: 12,
                          childAspectRatio: 1.0,
                        ),
                        itemCount: subjectProvider.subjects.length,
                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final subject = subjectProvider.subjects[index];
                          return Card(
                            color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                ? Colors.grey.shade900
                                : Theme.of(context).cardColor,
                            elevation: 3,
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                            ),
                            child: InkWell(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                              onTap: () {
                                Navigator.push(
                                  context,
                                  MaterialPageRoute(
                                    builder: (context) =>
                                        ChatScreen(subject: subject),
                                  ),
                                );
                              },
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                                    colors: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                        ? [
                                            Colors.grey.shade900,
                                            Colors.grey.shade900
                                          ]
                                        : [
                                            primaryColor.withValues(
                                                alpha: 0.15),
                                            primaryColor.withValues(
                                                alpha: 0.05),
                                          ],
                                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                child: Column(
                                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                  children: [
                                    CircleAvatar(
                                      radius: 28,
                                      backgroundColor:
                                          primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                                      child: Icon(
                                        subject.icon,
                                        color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                                            ? Colors.yellowAccent
                                            : primaryColor,
                                        size: 30,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                                    Text(
                                      subject.name,
                                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                      maxLines: 2,
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                                        overrideSize:
                                            accessibility.fontSize * 0.9,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        color: textColor,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: isTeacher
          ? FloatingActionButton.extended(
              onPressed: () => _showAddSubjectDialog(context),
              backgroundColor: primaryColor,
              icon: Icon(Icons.add,
                  color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                      ? Colors.black
                      : Colors.white),
              label: Text(
                'Nueva Materia',
                style: accessibility.getTextStyle(
                  color: accessibility.isHighContrast
                      ? Colors.black
                      : Colors.white,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : null,
    );
  }
}
